caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden picture frame displayed on a plain beige background, with the interior of the frame containing a portrait of a man in profile, facing left. The portrait itself shows a man with light skin and brown hair, neatly combed, wearing a dark blue or black jacket, a white high-collared shirt, and a black necktie. The man’s head is turned sideways, and the background behind him within the portrait is a light, muted color with soft shading. The frame around the portrait is rendered in golden yellow and light brown tones, with visible shading to give a three-dimensional appearance. At the bottom left of the drawing, the words “Actual Size” are written in small, plain letters.
title: Portrait
